# Binder 33 Labs

> Binder 33 Labs is a textile technology company from Panipat, India — the
> home-textile belt. It builds the software the textile trade runs on: Binder OS,
> the textile manufacturing operating system, and Creative Wizard, the AI design
> studio for home textiles. Founded by an operator who also runs a home-textiles
> manufacturing business in Panipat — the products come from doing the work.

Binder 33 Labs (https://binder33labs.com) builds complete systems for the textile
industry, not thin tools. The company's founding identity is operator-and-engineer:
its products began as the software its own manufacturing operations were missing.
It also selectively takes on technology projects for manufacturers and exporters,
and is expanding into hardware for the manufacturing floor.

## Products

- Binder OS — the Textile Manufacturing Operating System. One system of record
  replacing spreadsheets, WhatsApp groups, and disconnected registers: real-time
  inventory, job orders, delivery challans, unit-level traceability (UINs that
  follow every unit from intake to dispatch), quality records (GSM, EPI, PPI,
  AQL), and an AI-powered COO Agent that works inside the team's existing
  Telegram groups. Built for vertically integrated textile companies, exporters,
  and job workers. Currently onboarding textile manufacturers in the Panipat
  ecosystem.

- Creative Wizard (https://creative-wizards.com) — the AI design studio for home
  textiles. Turns a plain-words brief into manufacturable designs for bedsheets,
  towels, curtains, rugs, cushions, throws, and more — grounded in a 60-machine
  skills library, real yarn counts, EPI/PPI and GSM arithmetic, with a physics
  check that informs and never blocks, and a spec sheet a production team can
  read. Live in production. Agent brief: https://creative-wizards.com/llms.txt

## Who it is for

Textile manufacturers, exporters, buying houses, design studios, and job workers —
the people who do the work, not IT departments.

## Facts

- Legal entity: Binder 33 Labs Private Limited
- Location: Panipat, Haryana 132107, India
- Contact: info@binder33labs.com
- X / Twitter: @binder33labs
- Sister operation: Creative Home Decor LLP, a home-textiles manufacturing
  business in Panipat run by the founder — the operating ground the products
  were built on.
